findings.finding: Three of six Energy Drilling rigs roll off firm contracts by Q1 2027 with only one replacement filed: EDrill-1's firm term ended Nov 2026 and T-15's ends Jan 2027, with no follow-on on NewsWeb, and T-16 will sit idle in Singapore from about Q1 to early Q3 2027 before its new 30-month CPOC campaign. So the release's backlog and outlook comments on 2027 distribution capacity are the likely soft spot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior ENH print carried a cut to distribution capacity. The Q2 2025 print (-7.77%) is the nearest negative and is not attributable from the record. The T-16 award day (27 Oct 2026) took the stock from ~6.56 to 6.90.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the FY2027 consensus already has EPS down ~35% and revenue down ~16% (stockanalysis), and the stock is -9.3% over 60 days. What is not in a public number is whether EDrill-1 and T-15 have follow-on work. If the market had priced an idle EDrill-1, the 2027 revenue consensus would have fallen further after the November roll-off date, and nothing in the record shows that. The absence of a contract notice is an inference, so the finding is small.

findings.finding: SeaBird Exploration's Q3 was largely off-hire: Fulmar Explorer entered its five-year class yard stay in August, and Eagle Explorer was mobilising to India with operations only from about end-Q3. Group Q3 EBITDA therefore steps down from Q2's record, a likely miss against a Yahoo EPS bar ENH has missed four quarters running.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 to Q2 2026 EPS misses of 10-22% got +2.98%, -2.41% and +0.38%: misses on this line are not punished consistently.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: management stated the yard stay and the mobilisation in the Q2 materials. Only the size of the EPS gap is unknown, and that bar has been missed for four quarters without a consistent reaction. Toward 0.
findings.independence: Fulmar contract release of 2026-11-12 (mobilisation Dec 2026) confirms the vessel was not on a Q3 earning contract after the yard: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=686287

findings.finding: The Q3 distribution should land inside the company's own guide. H1 paid USD 50m against a FY guide of USD 90-110m, NIBD was 0.1x LTM EBITDA at Q2, and the USD 87m T-16 award and the Fulmar contract add backlog, so a ~USD 25m Q3 distribution and a reiterated guide are the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 print, with a USD 20m distribution and 'strategic delivery': +7.02%. Q1 2026 'increased shareholder distributions': -2.41%. Q2 2026, 25m and guide reiterated: +0.38%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the guided path, so it is priced by construction. Only a change to the guide would move the stock, and nothing sourced points to one. Inside guidance, so toward 0.
findings.independence: Q2 distribution date notices of 2026-11-04 and 11-05 keep the USD 25.0m amount unchanged: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=685738

findings.finding: The Ventura Offshore combination is still at LOI stage 11 weeks on. The definitive agreement is unsigned, and conditions include the January 2027 start of Ventura's new Petrobras contracts (DS Carolina, SSV Victoria). VTURA closed 26 Nov at NOK 32.0 against 5.5 x ENH 6.64 = 36.5, about a 12% discount to the exchange ratio. ENH has fallen ~10% since the LOI (7.34 on 10 Sep), and Ventura reports the same morning. The release's status update is two-sided for ENH.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: LOI day (11 Sep 2026): ENH -1.1% on 14.5m shares, VTURA +7.9%. ENH has since drifted to 6.64 with VTURA at a widening discount to the ratio.
findings.why_not_priced: The spread prices deal risk and ENH's discount prices dislike of the dilution, but nobody knows whether the release carries a signing, a delay or revised terms. Unsigned at 0 because the ENH sign of each outcome is ambiguous: a collapse could lift ENH, a signing could either way. It widens abs_move, not the lean.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': the SeaBird Q3 off-hire was stated in the Q2 materials, so -0.3 became -0.1
'Inside what the company guided': the Q3 distribution fits the 90-110m guide, so +0.2 became +0.1
'Macro-to-company/inference is smaller': the EDrill-1/T-15 roll-off rests on the absence of a contract notice, so -0.6 became -0.4

'In a live bid the offer is the finding' and 'too small about the move': the unsigned Ventura combination, with Ventura reporting the same morning, raised abs_move from 4.0 to 4.5 on a 3-analyst name, and p_up moved toward 50 (48 to 49)
